extractedText: Big Red Newsletter [Jan 2026] Report this article Tony Chen Tony Chen Published Feb 10, 2026 + Follow 🐻📈 Big Red News 🐻 I'm planning a Road Trip 2/19-2/23!! NYC, Boston, Maine, Providence, Hartford!!! I'm organizing several small gatherings, I really hope to see you!! 🐻 Eileen Higgins, MBA '89, is the new Mayor of Miami!! Miami is such a wonderful city, filled with optimism and opportunity, and the most amazing people!!! 🐻 Professor Dufresne runs Cornell's State Policy Advocacy Clinic, where students advocate for real issues, and pass real legislation in Albany!! 🐻 Office Hours at Cornell Tech went really well!!! 10 students and 1 alum came by!! I connected them with alumni, for advice on careers, for speakers for events, for events for startups!! the Cornell network is full of opportunities!!!! 🐻 I went to the Gym with a Cornellian!! we studied Electrical Engineering together at Cornell, and now we lift weights together in NYC!!! ECEs can do everything!! 🐻 20 Cornellians are running for Congress, and 11 of them are leading their Primaries!! Cornellians are the best Politicians!! 🐻 I made a list of Cornellian Federal Court Judges!! right now, we have 0 Supreme Court Judges, 11 Circuit Court of Appeal Judges, and 33 District Court Judges!! I hope more Cornellians become Federal Court Judges!! 🐻 I learned about Alzheimer's at the NY Public Library, taught by a Weill Cornell Professor!! Weill Cornell has the best Public Outreach!! such an informative lecture, with just the right amount of science to explain the why, so I felt more in control of my health!! 🐻 Weill Cornell Doctor looking for Interns!! if you're interested in breast cancer data analysis, reach out to Professor Magdalena Plasilova 🐻 hire a Weill Cornell Graduate Student!! Aubrey DeCarlo, Ph.D. runs Career Services for Weill Cornell, if you're hiring biomedical researchers, health policy, academic postdocs, equity research, venture capital, and more, please reach out!!! 🐻 Weill Cornell Impact magazine is the best medical magazine!! so much amazing research, amazing doctors, and amazing leadership!!! there's a new issue every quarter!! I get the latest issue at the Weill Cornell Hospital whenever I visit!! 🐻 Cornell launches the new Cornell Health Policy Center!! brings together the best Policy School in Ithaca and the best Medical School in NYC!! analyzes policy impacts, collects health data, and create policy briefs, so America would have the best health policy in the world!!!! 🎉 71 Cornellians came to the January Food Court Event!! my favorite thing about the Food Court Event, is how everyone is relaxed, just looking to connect with fellow Cornellians!! this makes the environment much more conducive for making long-term friendships!! Sign up for the February Food Court Event!! 🎉 I had a wonderful time at the Cornell Lunar New Year Banquet!! Cornellians come to the Banquet from all around the world, President Kotlikoff gave an amazing speech, and current students shared their experiences on campus!! Happy Year of the Horse!! 🎉 Cornell Engineering is now named the Duffield College of Engineering!! my favorite building on campus is Duffield Hall!! it's always open! I've met Cornellians there at 6am, I've met Cornellians there at 2am!! it's always open, always available!! 🎉 I woke up 6am to go to a Cornellian's Spin Class!! it's twice a week, at the Brooklyn Grind House!! Josh Grider '14 played football for Cornell, and is the best spin instructor, welcomes everyone into his class, super-patient, and super-motivating!! 🎉 I went running with a Cornellian in NYC!! we ran together in DC a decade ago, with the Cornell Club of DC, and now we run together in NYC!! Cornellians run together, everywhere we go, over the decades!! 🎉 for my personal brand, I want to be a normal Cornellian, without any title, easily approachable, only looking for one thing: to build long-term relationships with my fellow Cornellians!!! 🎉 I visited the newly renovated Waldorf Astoria on Park Ave!! Cornellians run the place!! from restaurant manager to guest services to finance and operations!!! the hotel reopened last July, after a $2b 8 year renovation!! 🎉 for MLK Day, I volunteered with Cornellians at a Food Pantry!! I helped move the bins of food from the weighing tables to the packaging tables!! it was amazing to see all the meals we helped prepare!!! 🎉 50 Cornellians visit The Met together!! Dan Kershaw '78 is the Exhibit Designer for The Met, and he gave us a tour, of how he created the Exhibits for The Met!! 🎉 Cornellian wrote a book!! about the marketing mindset, how being kind to people, creates a powerful brand!!! it's very practical, from building up your personal brand, to building your business brand!!! 🎉 Cornellian wrote a book!! "Pitch Your Potential" teaches you how to find jobs that are good fit, how to pitch yourself for those jobs, and get the best job for you!!!! 🎉 Cornell Center for Jewish Living is the most wonderful community!!!
